html:
Installation from source

For the UE 5.6.1 Win64 engine-wide alpha, see UE 5.6 alpha.

ForgeMCP's integration is free. Python 3.11+, Unreal Engine and Blender must be installed separately. Validated native development versions are Windows, Unreal 5.6.1 and Blender 5.2.2; this is not a claim of compatibility with every version. The core has no paid API or cloud-service requirement. Your chosen MCP client has its own installation, account and pricing terms.

External MCP server

Current component versions: server source 0.3.11, Blender add-on 0.2.35-alpha.6 (Blender numeric metadata 0.2.35). After updating source/installing the Blender add-on, save open scene work and reload Blender's add-on (or restart Blender), then restart the MCP server connection in the client so its tool registry refreshes. Verify both versions and the nine tools described in Blender creative automation. Copying installed files does not refresh a running Python module or MCP process.

Clone this repository into a directory of your choice, then run:

python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e '.[dev]' -c requirements-lock.txt

Configure your MCP client to launch the absolute path to .venv\Scripts\python.exe with arguments -m server.main and this checkout as its working directory. Set FORGE_PROJECT_ROOT to the checkout. The engine-wide Unreal plugin and Blender add-on register live sessions in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MajesticForge\sessions, allowing the MCP server to discover whichever applications are currently running without binding discovery to an Unreal project or the last project opened. Use FORGE_SESSION_DIR only when deliberately choosing a shared private session root; app-specific FORGE_UNREAL_SESSION_DIR and FORGE_BLENDER_SESSION_DIR overrides remain available for isolated tests and deployments. Never upload registration files: they contain credentials.

For Codex, scripts/configure_codex.py creates a local configuration. Do not set a project-specific Unreal session-directory override for engine-wide use. Other MCP clients can use the same stdio command.

Unreal plugin

Copy Plugins/Forge into your own project's Plugins directory. The directory is named Forge; keep the MajesticForge.uplugin descriptor filename and internal module IDs for compatibility. Build the project using Unreal's supported C++ toolchain; source-only clones do not include compiled DLLs. Enable ForgeMCP in Edit > Plugins and open Window > ForgeMCP. Save and close the relevant editor before replacing a loaded plugin. Unreal Engine's own license still applies.

Unreal's standard plugin packaging command is an alternative to building in your own C++ project (set the engine path to your installation):

$EngineRoot = '[local path]'
& "$EngineRoot\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\RunUAT.bat" BuildPlugin "-Plugin=$PWD\Plugins\Forge\MajesticForge.uplugin" "-Package=$PWD\Artifacts\UnrealPlugin" -TargetPlatforms=Win64

This invokes Unreal's native build tooling and requires its supported compiler. It is a source build instruction, not a claim that every engine target/version has been validated. Install the resulting plugin into a closed target project.

For a separate test host without personal settings or Marketplace dependencies:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/create_unreal_host.py --destination '[local path]'

The generator refuses existing directories. Open the generated .uproject with your matching engine and build its plugin. It does not replace the local development project. scripts/Build-ForgePlugin.ps1 is a machine-specific development workaround; it is not a portable substitute for Unreal's normal build toolchain.

Blender add-on

Build an installable source ZIP:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/package_blender_addon.py

In Blender, use Preferences > Add-ons > Install from Disk, select the generated Artifacts/ForgeMCP-Blender-Addon-<version>.zip, then enable ForgeMCP. Open the 3D Viewport sidebar with N and select ForgeMCP. The add-on uses Blender's Python runtime; the external server runs in the repository's separate environment.

For Send to Unreal, set ForgeMCP folder to your actual checkout. Start Blender with FORGE_UNREAL_SESSION_DIR pointing to the target project's private registration directory so the external worker can discover it. Select explicit session IDs when multiple sessions exist. Review the destination, saves and placement in the preview before confirming. Unsupported sources are rejected; current transfer support is static meshes, not rigged character or animation export.

Validation and support limits

Run Python regression checks using the commands in CONTRIBUTING.md. Native verification scripts must use disposable projects/profiles. Automated checks do not establish visible UI acceptance or general production readiness. Read the current capability record in Documentation/Active_Development_Plan.md before relying on an operation. Save your work before updating application adapters.
